NAME: Force Shadow - Skipback
DESCRIPTION: Continuously records the Force's real main-mix output into a rolling buffer, so a SHIFT+RECORD shortcut (or Force Crate Digger's own SKIPBACK REC button) can save the last N seconds retroactively (Schwung's Skipback feature). Auto-launches at boot once this addon's own manage.sh ENABLE has been run (confirmed safe against a live acvs restart - see manage.sh's own comment). Requires ForceShadow's forceAudioJack.so already armed. See docs/PROPOSAL-force-audio-jack.md.
